behavior_constraints: Build with make produces a nlsolve binary using gcc -O2 -lm.
CLI supports solve, analyze, generate-laplacian, generate-laplacian3d, and generate-rhs modes with the specified flags and defaults.
Matrix Market coordinate reader supports symmetric lower-triangle and general formats, expands symmetric storage internally, and converts 1-based indices to internal indexing.
Vector files are read and written as plain text with dimension followed by one value per line.
CG stops when ||r||_2 / ||b||_2 < tol and supports none, jacobi, ssor, and ic0 preconditioners.
BiCGSTAB stops with the same relative residual criterion and supports none, jacobi, and ssor preconditioners.
IC(0) uses zero-fill incomplete Cholesky on the lower-triangular sparsity pattern and is only valid for SPD matrices with CG.
SSOR uses omega=1.2.
RCM reordering is deterministic by node degree and original node index, permutes A and b consistently, and the reported solution is converted back to original ordering.
Analyze mode prints exactly dimension, nonzeros, symmetric, bandwidth, profile, and diag_dominant fields with the specified definitions.
entities.summary: Implement a complete C sparse matrix iterative solver toolkit named nlsolve with Matrix Market I/O, CG/BiCGSTAB solvers, Jacobi/SSOR/IC0 preconditioners, RCM reordering, matrix analysis, and 2D/3D Laplacian/RHS generators.

instruction_head:
Implement a sparse matrix iterative solver toolkit in C called `nlsolve`. The tool reads a linear system Ax = b from files and solves it using iterative methods, outputting the solution vector and convergence statistics. It also supports matrix analysis and bandwidth-reducing reordering.

## Matrix Format

Use the Matrix Market coordinate format (.mtx). The format is:

```
%%MatrixMarket matrix coordinate real symmetric
% optional comment lines
ROWS COLS NNZ
row col value
row col value
...
```

behavior_constraints: Every invalid-input path prints exactly one line `error: <description>` to stderr and exits with code 1
Missing or unreadable input files trigger the error path
Malformed Matrix Market headers trigger the error path
Non-numeric data in matrix or vector entries triggers the error path
NNZ count mismatches between header and data section trigger the error path
Extra trailing data beyond the declared entry count in matrix or vector files triggers the error path
Matrix-RHS dimension mismatches trigger the error path
Non-square matrices used in solver mode trigger the error path
Unknown solver, preconditioner, or reordering names trigger the error path
IC(0) factorization with zero or negative pivot prints an error and exits 1

behavior_constraints: After the solver loop finishes, residual_norm must be recomputed as ||b - A*x||_2 / ||b||_2 using the final solution vector, replacing the iteratively-updated residual value.
The converged field must be true if and only if the recomputed true residual is below the tolerance, regardless of the iterative residual.
Per-iteration --history lines must continue to print the iterative residual, not the true residual.
The iterations count reported must remain whatever the solver loop produced (unchanged by fix 1).
The Matrix Market reader must sum duplicate entries for the same (row, column) position into a single matrix element, both for raw file entries and for entries produced by symmetric expansion.
Symmetric expansion of a matrix with duplicate lower-triangle positions must merge all resulting duplicate COO entries before building CSR.
When ||b||_2 == 0, the solver must not be called; instead immediately output iterations: 0, residual_norm: 0.000000e+00, converged: yes, and all solution entries x[i] = 0.000000e+00.
The zero-RHS shortcut must apply to both CG and BiCGSTAB.
In SSOR forward and backward sweeps, if the diagonal entry for a row is exactly zero, the corresponding output component must be set to zero instead of dividing by zero.
All outputs for inputs that do not trigger these bugs must remain exactly the same as before.
entities.summary: Fix correctness bugs: report true residual and convergence after the solver loop, merge duplicate Matrix Market entries (including symmetric expansion), short-circuit zero-RHS cases to a zero solution, and guard SSOR sweeps against zero diagonal entries.

behavior_constraints: RCM must handle disconnected graphs by processing each connected component independently with pseudo-peripheral start and degree-ordered traversal
Each component's Cuthill-McKee ordering must be reversed independently before concatenating into the final permutation
Components must be concatenated in order of their smallest node index (component containing lowest-index node first)
GMRES(m) restarted solver must be available as `--solver gmres`
A `--restart <m>` parameter with default 30 must control the Krylov subspace dimension before restart
On restart, GMRES must use the current approximate solution as the new initial guess and recompute the residual
GMRES must check relative residual estimate against tol after each Krylov step and return updated solution when below tolerance
GMRES `--history` must print one line per inner iteration across all restart cycles with globally sequential numbering starting at 1
GMRES `iterations` output must be the total number of Krylov steps across all restarts
GMRES true residual reporting and `converged` field must behave identically to CG and BiCGSTAB
entities.summary: This round fixes RCM reordering to handle disconnected matrices by processing each connected component independently with component-wise reversal, and adds a restarted GMRES(m) solver with a `--restart` parameter, convergence/history semantics matching CG/BiCGSTAB, and preconditioner support plus dedicated error handling.
